<timestamp>Sunday, Aug 2, 2026, 6:22 PM (UTC-10)</timestamp>
<user_query>
You are on the operator’s Windows machine.

## Ask
Alex: **F G H drives, look into it plz. Its all the same microsd card I think**

## Do
1. Inspect volumes F:, G:, H: with PowerShell:
   - `Get-Volume`, `Get-Partition`, `Get-Disk`, `Get-PhysicalDisk`
   - Map each letter → DiskNumber, PartitionNumber, UniqueId, FriendlyName, SerialNumber, BusType, Size, FileSystem, MediaType
2. Determine whether F/G/H are multiple partitions on **one** physical microSD / USB reader device, or separate disks.
3. Also note any relation to the recent Ubuntu SanDisk installer (was Disk 4 / I:/J:) so he doesn’t confuse them.
4. Report clearly: one card vs multiple; safe to use which letter; do **not** wipe/format anything unless he asks.

Return a clear table of letter → disk identity.
</user_query>
I'll inspect F:, G:, and H: with PowerShell and map each letter to its physical disk identity.

input.command: Get-Volume | Format-Table DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, FileSystem, DriveType, Size, SizeRemaining -AutoSize; Write-Host '---PARTITIONS---'; Get-Partition | Format-Table DiskNumber, PartitionNumber, DriveLetter, Size, Type, GptType -AutoSize; Write-Host '---DISKS---'; Get-Disk | Format-Table Number, FriendlyName, SerialNumber, BusType, PartitionStyle, Size, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus -AutoSize; Write-Host '---PHYSICAL---'; Get-PhysicalDisk | Format-Table DeviceId, FriendlyName, SerialNumber, MediaType, BusType, Size, HealthStatus -AutoSize

content.text: F/G/H share Disk 3. Gathering UniqueIds and checking for any leftover SanDisk/Ubuntu volumes.

input.command:
Write-Host '=== F G H DETAIL ==='; foreach ($letter in @('F','G','H')) {
  $part = Get-Partition -DriveLetter $letter
  $disk = Get-Disk -Number $part.DiskNumber
  $phys = Get-PhysicalDisk | Where-Object { $_.DeviceId -eq $part.DiskNumber }
  $vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter $letter
  [PSCustomObject]@{
    Letter = $letter
    DiskNumber = $part.DiskNumber
    PartitionNumber = $part.PartitionNumber
    PartitionUniqueId = $part.UniqueId
    DiskUniqueId = $disk.UniqueId
    FriendlyName = $disk.FriendlyName
    SerialNumber = $disk.SerialNumber
    BusType = $disk.BusType
    DiskSizeGB = [math]::Round($disk.Size/1GB,2)
    PartitionSizeGB = [math]::Round($part.Size/1GB,2)
    FileSystem = $vol.FileSystem
    Label = $vol.FileSystemLabel
    MediaType = $phys.MediaType
    Path = $disk.Path
  }
} | Format-List; Write-Host '=== ALL REMOVABLE / USB DISKS ==='; Get-Disk | Where-Object { $_.BusType -eq 'USB' -or $_.Number -ge 3 } | Format-List Number, FriendlyName, SerialNumber, UniqueId, BusType, Size, PartitionStyle, Path; Write-Host '=== VOLUME UNIQUE IDS ==='; Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -in @('F','G','H') } | Format-List DriveLetter, UniqueId, Path, FileSystemLabel; Write-Host '=== CHECK I J Sandisk ==='; Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -in @('I','J','K') -or $_.FileSystemLabel -match 'Ubuntu|SanDisk|ISO|UBUNTU' } | Format-Table DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, FileSystem, Size -AutoSize; Get-Disk | Format-Table Number, FriendlyName, SerialNumber, Size -AutoSize; Write-Host '=== PARTITION OFFSETS DISK 3 ==='; Get-Partition -DiskNumber 3 | Format-Table PartitionNumber, DriveLetter, Offset, Size, Type -AutoSize
input.description: Map FGH UniqueIds and SanDisk check

input.command:
$rows = @(); foreach ($letter in @('F','G','H')) {
  $part = Get-Partition -DriveLetter $letter
  $disk = Get-Disk -Number $part.DiskNumber
  $phys = Get-PhysicalDisk | Where-Object { $_.DeviceId -eq [string]$part.DiskNumber }
  $vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter $letter
  $rows += [PSCustomObject]@{
    Letter = $letter
    DiskNumber = $part.DiskNumber
    PartitionNumber = $part.PartitionNumber
    PartitionUniqueId = $part.UniqueId
    DiskUniqueId = $disk.UniqueId
    FriendlyName = $disk.FriendlyName
    SerialNumber = ($disk.SerialNumber -replace '\s+$','')
    BusType = $disk.BusType
    DiskSizeGB = [math]::Round($disk.Size/1GB,2)
    PartitionSizeGB = [math]::Round($part.Size/1GB,2)
    FileSystem = $vol.FileSystem
    Label = $vol.FileSystemLabel
    MediaType = $phys.MediaType
  }
}; $rows | Format-List; Write-Host '=== USB DISKS ==='; Get-Disk | Where-Object { $_.BusType -eq 'USB' } | Format-List Number, FriendlyName, SerialNumber, UniqueId, BusType, Size, PartitionStyle, Path; Write-Host '=== VOL UNIQUE ==='; Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -match '^[FGH]$' } | Format-List DriveLetter, UniqueId, Path, FileSystemLabel; Write-Host '=== I/J/Ubuntu check ==='; Get-Volume | Format-Table DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, FileSystem, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}} -AutoSize; Write-Host '=== Disk3 partitions ==='; Get-Partition -DiskNumber 3 | Format-Table PartitionNumber, DriveLetter, @{N='OffsetMB';E={[math]::Round($_.Offset/1MB,1)}}, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, Type -AutoSize; Write-Host '=== All disks ==='; Get-Disk | Format-Table Number, FriendlyName, @{N='Serial';E={$_.SerialNumber.Trim()}}, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, BusType -AutoSize

input.final_summary: F:, G:, and H: are three partitions on one physical ~119 GB USB “Generic STORAGE DEVICE” (Disk 3, serial 000000000819) — almost certainly one microSD in a reader, not three cards. The Ubuntu SanDisk stick (old Disk 4 / I:/J:) is not plugged in right now. Use any of F/G/H for that card; nothing was wiped.
input.completed_subtitle: Mapped F G H as one card

content.text:
**Verdict: one physical card (Disk 3), three partitions → F / G / H.** Not three disks.

### Letter → disk identity

| Letter | Disk# | Part# | FriendlyName | Serial | Bus | Size | FS | Label | MediaType |
|--------|-------|-------|--------------|--------|-----|------|----|-------|-----------|
| **F:** | **3** | 1 | Generic STORAGE DEVICE | `000000000819` | USB | ~1.0 GB | FAT32 | BOOT | Unspecified |
| **G:** | **3** | 2 | Generic STORAGE DEVICE | `000000000819` | USB | ~39.7 GB | NTFS | Clean | Unspecified |
| **H:** | **3** | 3 | Generic STORAGE DEVICE | `000000000819` | USB | ~78.4 GB | FAT32 | *(blank)* | Unspecified |

**Shared disk UniqueId:** `USBSTOR\DISK&VEN_GENERIC&PROD_STORAGE_DEVICE&REV_0819\000000000819&0:rootatmus_prime`  
**Whole disk size:** ~119.08 GB (typical usable 128 GB microSD behind a generic reader)

Layout on Disk 3: BOOT (F) → Clean (G) → unlabeled FAT32 (H).

### Ubuntu SanDisk (old Disk 4 / I:/J:)

**Not present now.** No I:/J:, no SanDisk-named disk. Current USB disks are only:
- Disk 2 — JMicron Tech → **E:** Portable Archive (~2 TB) — separate enclosure
- Disk 3 — Generic STORAGE DEVICE → **F/G/H** — this card

Don’t confuse F/G/H with E: or with the installer stick if you plug that SanDisk back in later (it would show as another disk / letters).

### Safe to use

Any of **F, G, or H** is the same microSD; letter = which partition. Nothing wiped or formatted.
